name: io.github.Servosity/proxmox-mcp
title: Proxmox MCP
description: Read-only Proxmox VE and Backup Server: which client guests have a verified, recent restore point.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Proxmox VE host name or IP (API on port 8006).

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Proxmox VE API token USER@REALM!TOKENID=SECRET; PVEAuditor, plus Datastore.AllocateSpace and VM.Backup if backups live on PVE storage.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_TLS_FINGERPRINT
environmentVariables.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the PVE certificate to pin (stock Proxmox certificates are self-signed).

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_PBS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Optional Proxmox Backup Server host, host:port, or https://host:port (default port 8007).

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_PBS_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional Proxmox Backup Server API token USER@REALM!TOKENID:SECRET (colon before the secret).

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_PBS_TLS_FINGERPRINT
environmentVariables.description: Optional SHA-256 fingerprint of the PBS certificate to pin.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full PVE API base such as https://pve1:8006/api2/json; overrides PROXMOX_HOST. Leave blank to use PROXMOX_HOST.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_CLUSTER
environmentVariables.description: Name of the clusters.toml entry to use by default (same as --cluster). Leave blank to run across every configured cluster.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_CLUSTERS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the clusters.toml that lists client clusters. Leave blank for the default. Each cluster's token variables must also be in the server's environment.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Proxmox requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to drop the sync, export, workflow archive and learnings forget/reject MCP tools. The learning-store tools (teach, playbook) still write locally. Proxmox itself is never written either way. Leave blank for the full tool set.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment); the server refuses to start without it. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Leave blank. This connector registers no tenant-gated profile source, so the value is read but changes nothing; select client clusters with PROXMOX_CLUSTER or clusters.toml instead.
